card.name: Inside drug names before 'and' or dosage form
card.fires_on: The last pieces of a drug's generic name, or the dosage-form word after it, in label text. It fires when the name is part of a combination or is followed by a form such as tablets, oral solution or transdermal system.

modes.description: Final pieces of a generic name, often right before 'and' and a second drug.
